vi Create_Tag.vi :
  uses :
    subVI   Choose_Lib.vi      ; ./Choose_Lib.vi
    typedef PLC_Attributes.ctl ; ./PLC_Attributes.ctl
    subVI   Trim Whitespace.vi
    typedef whitespace.ctl
  front-panel :
    pattern : 4815
    in   PLC Attributes      : PLC_Attributes @11
    in   timeout             : I32            @10
    in   error in (no error) : Error          @8
    out  "handle "           : I32            @3
    out  error code          : I32            @2
    out  error out           : Error          @0
  block-diagram :
    subVI Choose_Lib_569 : Choose_Lib.vi
      in   error in (no error) : Error = error in (no error)
      out  Path to Library     : Path
      out  error out           : Error
    function Bundle/Unbundle_By_Name_8120 : Bundle/Unbundle By Name
      in   0             : PLC_Attributes = PLC Attributes
      out  protocol      : String
      out  gatewayIP     : String
      out  path          : String
      out  cpu           : String
      out  element size  : String
      out  element count : String
      out  tag name      : String
      out  debug level   : String
    subVI Trim_Whitespace_651 : Trim Whitespace.vi
      in   string          : String = Bundle/Unbundle_By_Name_8120::protocol
      in   location (both) : U16    default 0
      out  trimmed string  : String
    subVI Trim_Whitespace_8305 : Trim Whitespace.vi
      in   string          : String = Bundle/Unbundle_By_Name_8120::gatewayIP
      in   location (both) : U16    default 0
      out  trimmed string  : String
    subVI Trim_Whitespace_8341 : Trim Whitespace.vi
      in   string          : String = Bundle/Unbundle_By_Name_8120::path
      in   location (both) : U16    default 0
      out  trimmed string  : String
    subVI Trim_Whitespace_8360 : Trim Whitespace.vi
      in   string          : String = Bundle/Unbundle_By_Name_8120::cpu
      in   location (both) : U16    default 0
      out  trimmed string  : String
    subVI Trim_Whitespace_8390 : Trim Whitespace.vi
      in   string          : String = Bundle/Unbundle_By_Name_8120::element size
      in   location (both) : U16    default 0
      out  trimmed string  : String
    subVI Trim_Whitespace_8409 : Trim Whitespace.vi
      in   string          : String = Bundle/Unbundle_By_Name_8120::element count
      in   location (both) : U16    default 0
      out  trimmed string  : String
    subVI Trim_Whitespace_8421 : Trim Whitespace.vi
      in   string          : String = Bundle/Unbundle_By_Name_8120::tag name
      in   location (both) : U16    default 0
      out  trimmed string  : String
    subVI Trim_Whitespace_8433 : Trim Whitespace.vi
      in   string          : String = Bundle/Unbundle_By_Name_8120::debug level
      in   location (both) : U16    default 0
      out  trimmed string  : String
    function Equal?_869 : Equal?
      in   y     : String = "'NONE'"
      in   x     : String = Trim_Whitespace_8433::trimmed string
      out  equal : TF
    case Equal?_869::equal :
      frame "False" :
        function Concatenate_Strings_1147 : Concatenate Strings
          in   1 : String = "'&debug='"
          in   2 : String = Trim_Whitespace_8433::trimmed string
          out  0 : String
        case_940::out0 = Concatenate_Strings_1147::0
      frame "True" :
        case_940::out0 = "''"
    function Concatenate_Strings_224 : Concatenate Strings
      in   1  : String = "'protocol='"
      in   2  : String = Trim_Whitespace_651::trimmed string
      in   3  : String = "'&gateway='"
      in   4  : String = Trim_Whitespace_8305::trimmed string
      in   5  : String = "'&path='"
      in   6  : String = Trim_Whitespace_8341::trimmed string
      in   7  : String = "'&cpu='"
      in   8  : String = Trim_Whitespace_8360::trimmed string
      in   9  : String = "'&elem_size='"
      in   10 : String = Trim_Whitespace_8390::trimmed string
      in   11 : String = "'&elem_count='"
      in   12 : String = Trim_Whitespace_8409::trimmed string
      in   13 : String = "'&name='"
      in   14 : String = Trim_Whitespace_8421::trimmed string
      in   15 : String = case_940::out0
      out  0  : String
    function plc_tag_create_43 : plc_tag_create
      in   path in             : Path   = Choose_Lib_569::Path to Library
      in   error in (no error) : Error  = Choose_Lib_569::error out
      in   IP address          : String = Concatenate_Strings_224::0
      in   timeout             : I32    = timeout
      out  path out            : Path
      out  error out           : Error
      out  return type         : I32
      out  IP address output   : String
      out  timeout output      : I32
    function Less_Than_0?_116 : Less Than 0?
      in   x      : I32 = plc_tag_create_43::return type
      out  result : TF
    function Select_139 : Select
      in   f_value  : I32 = 0
      in   selector : TF  = Less_Than_0?_116::result
      in   t_value  : I32 = plc_tag_create_43::return type
      out  result   : I32
    function Select_153 : Select
      in   f_value  : I32 = plc_tag_create_43::return type
      in   selector : TF  = Less_Than_0?_116::result
      in   t_value  : I32 = -1
      out  result   : I32
    "handle " = Select_153::result
    error code = Select_139::result
    error out = plc_tag_create_43::error out
